speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The pilot with MEF provided useful insights which have helped IMDA to set up SSIR quickly.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: In addition, SSIR will offer a more affordable pricing model to enable more widespread participation, especially for SMEs that are interested to sign up for the service.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Organisations, such as the Association of Banks in Singapore (ABS), Mobile Network Operators and SMS service providers, are in full support of SSIR, which continues to onboard new organisations interested in protecting their SMS Sender IDs.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Will SSIR be made mandatory for banks and Government agencies?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: What agencies will be exempted and what penalties will be meted out if the required agencies do not join the registry?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: With the pricing model, we hope that it is affordable, especially for SMEs.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: This makes it more affordable for smaller companies and organisations, such as SMEs, which would have fewer Sender IDs to register.
